justifications.safety: Gentle mystery with an off-page drowning referenced obliquely; no graphic violence, sexual content, or substance use — suitable for a general/child audience.
justifications.continuity: As the opening paragraph there is nothing to contradict, and all invented details (Wren, Elias Ashcombe, the lighthouse, the village) are self-consistent and establish rather than conflict.
justifications.voice_match: Sets its own consistent register — past tense, close third limited on Wren, lyrical atmospheric prose — with no internal shifts in POV or tense.
justifications.single_turn: Exactly one paragraph that advances the story to a clear hook, with no meta-commentary, author labels, or resolution of a partner's turn.
